title: Transformer 注意力編解碼器
summary: 以QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算解析Transformer 注意力編解碼器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Transformer attention encoder-decoder through qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Transformer 注意力編解碼器案例中比較token與位置張量與softmax(QKᵀ/√d)V，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate token and position tensors and softmax(qkᵀ/sqrt(d))v within the Transformer attention encoder-decoder case.

steps.title: 縮放點積注意力：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對token與位置張量提出可反駁的縮放點積注意力模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scaled dot-product attention model and evidence record for token and position tensors.
steps.instruction: 在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識token與位置張量。QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。 建立縮放點積注意力的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify token and position tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scaled dot-product attention, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。
steps.observationEn: Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：注意力權重就是所有token的固定平均。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Attention weights are a fixed average over every token.
steps.check: 提交token與位置張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for token and position tensors.

knowledge.title: 縮放點積注意力
knowledge.text: QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。 本課架構對應：token與位置張量
knowledge.textEn: Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs. Course architecture correspondence: Token and position tensors

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；注意力權重就是所有token的固定平均。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Attention weights are a fixed average over every token.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(80×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=245760 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=31744 byte，算術強度=7.7419 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(80x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 245760 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 31744 bytes, intensity 7.7419 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

quiz.question: 就token與位置張量的「縮放點積注意力」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for scaled dot-product attention in token and position tensors?
options: QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。
注意力權重就是所有token的固定平均。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs.
Attention weights are a fixed average over every token.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。 用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。
quiz.explanationEn: Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs. Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions.

steps.title: 縮放點積注意力：證據驗證
steps.objective: 針對token與位置張量提出可反駁的縮放點積注意力模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scaled dot-product attention model and evidence record for token and position tensors.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「縮放點積注意力」模型，檢查token與位置張量的兩個假想案例。用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous scaled dot-product attention model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving token and position tensors. Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。
steps.observationEn: Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：注意力權重就是所有token的固定平均。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Attention weights are a fixed average over every token.
steps.check: 提交token與位置張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for token and position tensors.

steps.title: 遮罩與資訊流：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Masks and information flow: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對softmax(QKᵀ/√d)V提出可反駁的遮罩與資訊流模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable masks and information flow model and evidence record for softmax(qkᵀ/sqrt(d))v.
steps.instruction: 在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識softmax(QKᵀ/√d)V。因果遮罩排除未來位置；padding遮罩處理無效token，兩者服務不同條件。 建立遮罩與資訊流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在小型score矩陣分別畫兩種遮罩並檢查可見位置。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify softmax(qkᵀ/sqrt(d))v in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Causal masks exclude future positions; padding masks exclude invalid tokens and serve different conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of masks and information flow, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw both masks on a small score matrix and inspect visible positions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在小型score矩陣分別畫兩種遮罩並檢查可見位置。
steps.observationEn: Draw both masks on a small score matrix and inspect visible positions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：padding遮罩可自動防止所有未來資訊洩漏。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A padding mask automatically prevents all future leakage.
steps.check: 提交softmax(QKᵀ/√d)V的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for softmax(qkᵀ/sqrt(d))v.

knowledge.text: 在小型score矩陣分別畫兩種遮罩並檢查可見位置。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；padding遮罩可自動防止所有未來資訊洩漏。 是本單元要排除的誤解。

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for masks and information flow in softmax(qkᵀ/sqrt(d))v?
options: padding遮罩可自動防止所有未來資訊洩漏。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
因果遮罩排除未來位置；padding遮罩處理無效token，兩者服務不同條件。
optionsEn: A padding mask automatically prevents all future leakage.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Causal masks exclude future positions; padding masks exclude invalid tokens and serve different conditions.
quiz.explanation: 因果遮罩排除未來位置；padding遮罩處理無效token，兩者服務不同條件。 在小型score矩陣分別畫兩種遮罩並檢查可見位置。
quiz.explanationEn: Causal masks exclude future positions; padding masks exclude invalid tokens and serve different conditions. Draw both masks on a small score matrix and inspect visible positions.
